unlisted_practices: Develop and evaluate clinical decision support systems iteratively, with user-centered design that includes user engagement, feedback, monitoring and evaluation.
Match evaluation objectives and methods to the maturity stage of the tool, from functionality, feasibility and usability early on to effectiveness, efficiency and cost-effectiveness later.
Evaluate the whole deployment of a clinical decision support system, including training, supervision and IT maintenance.
Design and implement digital tools in line with the Principles for Digital Development.
Digitize clinical guidelines rigorously by developing, documenting and validating each layer of the WHO SMART guidelines.
Prefer open standards, interoperability and reusable open-source components when developing clinical decision support systems.
Collaborate through communities of practice and coordinated digital health groups to develop clinical decision support systems and fill evidence gaps on effectiveness and cost-effectiveness at scale.
Design clinical decision support systems for scalability and sustainability, with a sustainability plan and integration into national health planning.
Have clinical decision support systems propose diagnoses and treatments while leaving the final decision to the provider.
Use mandatory assessment steps in clinical decision support systems to ensure systematic evaluation.

screen.reason: This is a commentary/advocacy article discussing the design, implementation, and evaluation of pediatric clinical decision support systems (CDSS) for global health.
